# VoxBridge Compose 0.2.0

This release substantially improves live transcript refinement, embedded-model
management, provider switching, and hardware status reporting.

## Highlights

- Reworked live refinement around a confirmed prefix and revisable recent tail.
  Model passes are serialized, new speech is coalesced, and results replace only
  the exact source span that produced them.
- Added safeguards against duplicated phrases, missing or reordered sentences,
  copied context, malformed joins, paragraph collapse, prompt leakage, moved
  clauses, and newly introduced tiny sentence fragments.
- Recording finalization now waits for outstanding recognition and performs one
  authoritative whole-document reconciliation.
- Qwen3 4B Instruct 2507 Q4_K_M is now the recommended embedded model, with a
  lighter Qwen2.5 1.5B option and support for custom GGUF files.
- Added managed-model installation state, downloads, preload progress, and a
  combined graphics-memory capacity check before download.
- Made Embedded/Ollama switching generation-aware so an older initialization or
  inference result cannot override the user's latest provider selection.
- Added whole-document topic filename suggestions with a safe local fallback.
- Restored system-memory reporting and expanded graphics-memory reporting with
  separate speech-recognition and text-refinement estimates. Local Ollama memory
  is read from its runtime when available; network Ollama remains explicitly
  unmeasured.
- Improved status messaging for downloads, initialization, warmup, recognition,
  refinement, provider switching, and final reconciliation.

## Compatibility notes

- Existing installations that still use the former bundled default model are
  migrated to the new recommended default. Custom model paths are preserved.
- Existing downloaded model files are not deleted.
- Network Ollama remains supported and receives transcript text only, never
  recorded audio.
- Windows is the primary tested platform. Linux packages remain available but
  should be treated as pre-release until tested more broadly.

## Credits

VoxBridge Compose is an independently maintained derivative of
[FOSS Voquill](https://voquill.org/) by Jack Brumley and its contributors.
Please consider [supporting the original project](https://voquill.org/donate.html).

The recommended embedded model is
[Qwen3 4B Instruct 2507](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507),
distributed in GGUF form by
[Unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF).

The independently implemented streaming architecture was informed by research
on incremental-recognition stability and bounded revisions, including
[*Stability and Accuracy in Incremental Speech Recognition*](https://aclanthology.org/W11-2014/),
[*Estimating Word-Stability During Incremental Speech Recognition*](https://research.google/pubs/estimating-word-stability-during-incremental-speech-recognition/),
[*Turning Whisper into a Real-Time Transcription System*](https://aclanthology.org/2023.ijcnlp-demo.3/),
[*Improving Stability in Simultaneous Speech Translation*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.04399),
and the work associated with
[SimulStreaming](https://aclanthology.org/2025.iwslt-1.41/). See the repository's
NOTICE for author-level credits, reference implementations, and licensing context.
